props: Any 3-hydroxy steroid whose skeleton is closely related to cholestan-3-ol (additional carbon atoms may be present in the side chain).

nodes.label: S2P
props: Endopeptidase S2P; Sterol regulatory element-binding proteins intramembrane protease
